function mergeInteractionHistory_(groups) {
  const seen={},merged=[]; (groups || []).forEach(function(group) {(group.items || []).forEach(function(item) {const id=String(item.interactionId || ''); if (!id || seen[id]) return; seen[id]=true; const copy=Object.assign({},item);copy.historyStage=group.historyStage || '';merged.push(copy);});});
  return merged.sort(function(a,b) {const at=new Date(a.createdAt || 0).getTime(),bt=new Date(b.createdAt || 0).getTime(); return at!==bt ? bt-at : String(b.interactionId || '').localeCompare(String(a.interactionId || ''));});
